name: Conflicting script versions
description: Flags byte-different copies of the same script in separate source directories. Identity is the path under the script root, so User/Foo.psc does not conflict with Other/Foo.psc.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a `.psc` file when another script search directory contains a byte-different copy of the same script (determined by MD5). Identity is the path relative to the search root, case-insensitively: Fallout 4 / Starfield `A:B:C` is `A/B/C.psc`, so equal stems in different namespace folders stay distinct while the same qualified path across roots is compared. An unqualified script is still just its file name. Byte-identical copies are ignored. Only available when linting a file with project context in the desktop app or CLI.
